sideA.text:
THIS PACKAGE INCLUDES:
• 18 cards • 4 sticker cards
• 6 satellite towers miniatures

RECON REPORT

There is infestation here; vermin
carrying the plague run through
the cities. The abandonment
of supply lines by our haven
leadership has driven much of
the world to the brink.

Old satellite towers dot the
landscape. We can use them to
broadcast information to each
other, which should cut down
our need for travel on the
ever-growing grid.

Read both sides of this card
then keep it in the reserve.

sideB.text:
RIGHT NOW!

Open the following doors if you have not
done so already:
57  F  14

You have connected a new city:
Kinshasa.
• Add the Player card for Kinshasa
to the Player discard pile.
• Add the Infection card for Kinshasa
to the Game End area.
• Put the other Player and Infection cards
included in this package into the reserve.
• Finally, give the "TOPAZ Experimental
Vaccine" Unrationed Event card to a player
to add to their hand.

rules: On opening the package, open doors 57, F, and 14 if they are not already open.
Kinshasa joins the grid. Its Player card goes to the Player discard pile.
Kinshasa's Infection card goes to the Game End area, so it cannot be drawn.
Every other Player card and Infection card in this package goes to the reserve.
Give the TOPAZ Experimental Vaccine Unrationed Event to a player, into their hand.
Keep this report in the reserve after both sides have been read.
notes: The package lists 18 cards, 4 sticker cards, and 6 satellite tower miniatures. The Satellite Towers bag holds those 6 miniatures.

Cities in the reserve are Khartoum, Dar es Salaam, Johannesburg, and Antananarivo, plus Kinshasa's extra cards if any are not the one Player card and one Infection card placed by the bullets above. Kinshasa has exactly one Player card and one Infection card, so both of those are placed and none of Kinshasa's cards go to the reserve.
